content: AI incident/severity triage best practice: confidence-threshold routing — high confidence auto-queued with retrospective audit, medium confidence presented for analyst validation, low confidence routed to full human review. Severity-calibrated escalation: highest-severity failures trigger mandatory human escalation, mid-severity gets periodic sampling, low-severity handled automatically — concentrating human attention where judgment matters. Explainability required: every AI decision needs a visible reasoning chain (signals used, uncertainty, missing evidence) or analysts blindly accept/reject and errors propagate undetected. Recommended rollout: crawl-walk-run, not full automation at once.
